summary: Learn basin water balances, allocation criteria and governance records through applied exercises. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: Water allocation and governance connect basin supply, seasonal demand and allocation rules in documented decisions. For water-resource planners, allocation officers and governance professionals, the course covers building basin water balances in Excel, comparing demand and supply scenarios, recording allocation criteria and responsibilities, and preparing monitoring indicators and review records using IWRM and water-accounting concepts.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who develop, administer or review water-allocation decisions and the evidence behind them.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with water-resource planning, water allocation or basin operations. Basic experience reading water-use or flow data is helpful. No coding is required.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
